title: Leaded stained glass in three layouts
purpose: Generate tileable maps of leaded stained glass: irregular cathedral pieces, diamond quarries or circles in squares, each pane a hashed glass colour with streaks and seed bubbles in raised lead came, with an emissive map of the light through it. Use for church, Victorian and fantasy windows and lamps.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python stained_glass.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: layout
parameters.meaning: 0 irregular cathedral pieces, 1 diamond quarries, 2 circles in squares.

parameters.name: lead_width
parameters.meaning: Width of the lead came as a share of a pane.

parameters.name: streaks
parameters.meaning: Streaks and density variation in the glass.

parameters.name: seeds
parameters.meaning: Tiny seed bubbles trapped in the glass.

parameters.name: glow
parameters.meaning: Brightness of the light through the glass in the emissive map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the light in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Cathedral glass: irregular jewel-coloured pieces in dark lead.

presets.name: diamond_quarries
presets.description: Leaded diamond panes of pale tinted glass with a few coloured ones.

presets.name: victorian_circles
presets.description: Ruby circles in amber squares with cobalt accents, Victorian style.

presets.name: amber_opalescent
presets.description: Large streaky opalescent amber and green pieces with thin copper foil.

limits: A flat panel without refraction, transmission depth or painted figures and grisaille. Glass colour, streaks and bubbles are stylized; streak directions come from a small set of whole-number vectors so they repeat across the tile edge. Solder blobs are drawn only where quarry leads cross. Backlighting is an emissive map of glass colour, not a light transport model, and the engine sets its strength. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Worley cells for irregular cathedral panes
Diamond lattice from n(u + v) and n(u - v)
Circles inscribed in a square grid
Hashed weighted palette choice per pane
Exact border distance with a rounded came profile
Directional sine streaks on whole-number vectors with noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
